newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA BOARD OFFERS 75,000 TONNES WHITE MAIZE.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA BOARD OFFERS 75,000 TONNES WHITE MAIZE.

text.p: South Africa's Maize Board said on Friday it will offer up to 75,000 tonnes of white maize for domestic use or export during December.
The tender will close on November 12, with the results expected the following day, the Board said in a statement.
It said the tenders for export will be in units of 25,000 tonnes, while those for domestic use may be up to 75,000 tonnes.
The minimum price the Board will consider for domestic tenders will be import parity plus 20 rand, the Board said.
